works.title: Andreas
works.author: Cynewulf
works.description: An Old English poem recounting the life and missionary journey of Saint Andrew among the cannibalistic Mermedonians. A vivid example of Anglo-Saxon heroic Christian poetry.

works.title: Bang-E-Dara Part 1
works.author: Allama Iqbal
works.description: The first part of Bang-e-Dara (The Call of the Marching Bell), Allama Iqbal's groundbreaking collection of Urdu poetry. This section introduces his powerful vision of Islamic renaissance and individual empowerment through faith.

works.title: Bang-E-Dara Part 2
works.author: Allama Iqbal
works.description: The second part of Bang-e-Dara (The Call of the Marching Bell), continuing Allama Iqbal's exploration of Islamic philosophy, self-realization, and the spiritual destiny of Muslims in the modern world.

works.title: Bang-E-Dara Part 3
works.author: Allama Iqbal
works.description: The third part of Bang-e-Dara (The Call of the Marching Bell), a seminal collection of Urdu poetry by Allama Iqbal. This section contains powerful verses on Islamic philosophy, nationalism, and spiritual awakening.

works.title: Diwan-E-Ghalib
works.author: Mirza Ghalib
works.description: The complete collection of ghazals by Mirza Ghalib, one of the greatest Urdu poets. His verses express profound emotions, philosophical reflections, and masterful use of metaphor and imagery in classical Urdu tradition.

works.title: Diwan-E-Zauq
works.author: Sheikh Ibrahim Zauq
works.description: The complete collection of ghazals by Sheikh Ibrahim Zauq, a master of classical Urdu poetry and court poet of the last Mughal emperor. His verses showcase refined classical style and mastery of the Urdu language.

works.title: Elene
works.author: Cynewulf
works.description: An Old English poem narrating the finding of the True Cross by Saint Helena, mother of Constantine the Great. A masterpiece of Anglo-Saxon religious narrative poetry combining history with spiritual devotion.

works.title: Juliana
works.author: Cynewulf
works.description: An Old English hagiographic poem telling the story of Saint Juliana of Nicomedia, her resistance to marriage with a pagan, and her martyrdom. A classic example of Anglo-Saxon Christian devotional poetry.

works.title: Old English Elegies
works.author: Unknown
works.description: A collection of Old English elegiac poems expressing themes of exile, loss, and the transience of earthly life. These works represent the poignant reflections of Anglo-Saxon culture and spirituality.

works.title: Traité de la propriété: VOL I
works.author: Charles Comte
works.description: Traité de la propriété (1834) by Charles Comte presents a sweeping philosophical and legal theory of private property. Comte argues that liberty is the foundation of rights, and that occupation and appropriation of things flow naturally from human freedom. He criticizes ancient jurisprudence grounded in slavery, claiming it undermines genuine property rights. He traces the formation of property from individual acquisition of things, through communal and national levels, exploring territory, value and legal guarantees. Comte thus frames property as essential for human development and social progress.
